title: fix(kql): write typed null literals for null values

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@ and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0
 
 ### Fixed
 
+- Null values added as query parameters or through the KQL builder are now written as typed null literals (such as `dynamic(null)` or `int(null)`). A null `Dynamic` was written as an empty `dynamic()`, and the other null types caused a panic.
 - KQL builders and query parameters now format negative timespans with a single leading sign and preserve the day component.
 
 ## [1.2.4] - 2026-11-26

@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+package kql
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/Azure/azure-kusto-go/azkustodata/value"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestNullValueLiterals(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		value value.Kusto
+		want  string
+	}{
+		{value.NewNullBool(), "bool(null)"},
+		{value.NewNullDateTime(), "datetime(null)"},
+		{value.NewNullDecimal(), "decimal(null)"},
+		{value.NewNullDynamic(), "dynamic(null)"},
+		{value.NewNullGUID(), "guid(null)"},
+		{value.NewNullInt(), "int(null)"},
+		{value.NewNullLong(), "long(null)"},
+		{value.NewNullReal(), "real(null)"},
+		{value.NewNullTimespan(), "timespan(null)"},
+	}
+	for _, test := range tests {
+		t.Run(test.want, func(t *testing.T) {
+			params := NewParameters().AddValue("p", test.value).ToParameterCollection()
+			require.Equal(t, map[string]string{"p": test.want}, params)
+			require.Equal(t, test.want, New("").AddValue(test.value).String())
+		})
+	}
+}
